[[File:Robich_Duggsin_Helmet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Robich Duggsin's flight helmet]]
'''Robich Duggsin''' was a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Initially part of the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces]], Duggsin was part of the four-pilot contingent that was reallocated to [[Great Temple|Base One]] on [[Yavin 4]]. Transferred to [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], Duggsin flew as [[Blue Seven]] during the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />
